shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat ground
bearded male figure(s) with elaborate coiffure/headgear
long straight shafted weapon (spear/lance) held vertically or diagonally
patterned garment with fine incised parallel lines/fringes
figures facing the same direction in a single register
justification: Both are profile-view low relief with bearded, elaborately coiffed male figures equipped with the same specific attributes — a bow and a long straight spear/shaft — and both use finely incised parallel lines for hair, beard and drapery. However A is a dynamic multi-figure hunting/battle scene with a chariot, galloping horses and collapsing lions, while B shows a single static standing guard-like figure with grounded spear and no animals or vehicles, so the compositional relationships are quite different.
